result: Cause found: the build tag hashed every crates/ file, so test-only trains rebuilt ld/libc/ldconfig. Fixed: the tag covers product inputs only, and a build-time check fails any uncovered input. Most rebuilds (46/52) are still required by product changes; cross-host products are byte-identical but arrive ~25 min too late to reuse
head: f579c3e7d

rulings.item: Build the train's release products first on the Skylake-SP host and import them into ci-instr (xtask import mode that checks tag, head, toolchain and profile; a cache trust boundary)
rulings.recommendation: a follow-up story; first prove the final libraries byte-identical across hosts, then consider sharing the traced-layout step too (588-804 s per run)

informational: so/libc-archive (traced layout) costs 588-804 s in every ci-instr run, more than the rebuild
CARGO_LOG=cargo::core::compiler::fingerprint=info prints nothing on cargo 1.99.1; CARGO_LOG=cargo=info works
the replay's trace-at-build step fails inside unshare -r -m (perf script: Map missing from maps), after the cargo steps
build_tag walks the tree about 8 times per cargo xtask so

both keke replays bind-mounted a copy at the ci-instr role path inside unshare -r -m, which made the role look busy to the CI (train 899 instr check delayed); exp2 was ended by the coordinator and is not used as proof

impact.what: ci-instr cargo wait for an edit no product compiles (replay on a copy of ci-instr, Zen 1 host): ld/libc/ldconfig
impact.unit: s (sum of the three step waits, r2 vs r4)

impact.what: ci-instr median wall time, rebuilt vs reused runs since 11-19 (the saving per train whose change has no product input, ~6 of 52)
the build tag now covers spec/encoding/iconv-aliases.tsv (a niji-core compile-time input the old tag missed), and a product build fails if the tag misses any input
unit tests for the tag set and the check, plus plants
impact.unit: plants (9 caught by the tests, 2 by the build-time check)

improvement: the brief told me to run on a copy of the ci-instr tree, and I bind-mounted it at the live path to keep the absolute paths, which blocked a train: briefs should say a CI role path is never used, even in a namespace, and offer the live job fingerprint logs (the coordinator now does). The brief CARGO_LOG filter is silent on cargo 1.99.1 (use cargo=info)
next_step: coordinator: turn on CARGO_LOG=cargo=info in the live ci-instr command for a few trains to get cargo own reasons for real rebuilt runs; after landing, measure ci-instr on trains with no product change
